title: 第1章 觉醒的武魂
content_zh:
九霄大陆，武道为尊，弱小的武者，都有千、万斤巨力，开碑裂石；而强大的武者，可斩断河流、劈开大山；更有武道皇者，通天彻地，遨游太虚。

武道，决定命运，决定生死，弱者，受人欺凌，强者，俯瞰天下。

武魂，九霄大陆之人与生俱来的天赋，是武者的魂魄，可以说武者的成就，与他的武魂息息相关。

武魂种类无数，有自然武魂，火焰、冰魄、飓风、雷电等；有器武魂，刀、枪、剑、戟；有兽武魂，白虎、狂犀、暴猿、龙蛇；当然还有许多强大的异种武魂，比如狂化武魂、不死武魂；武魂，他能够随着武者实力提升而不断进化变强。

林枫睁开眼睛，盯着眼前古色生香的房间，陌生而又熟悉的房间，他的眼中露出一丝无奈的苦涩笑容。

“这也算大难不死吧！”林枫心中嘀咕了一声，顿时苦涩的笑容化为乌有，嘴角浮现一抹笑容。

没错，林枫他穿越了，他本来是地球华夏国江南市的一名大四学生，因为一场车祸，他穿越来到九霄大陆，附身在一个和他同名的家族子弟身上。

林枫有些郁闷，不过并非因为穿越而郁闷，在地球上，他是一名遗孤，是爷爷一手拉扯长大的，因为劳累过度，爷爷在看到林枫大学录取通知书的那一刻终于安心的闭上了眼，留下了一笔在乡下算是非常丰厚的几万块存款给林枫读大学，就为了留这笔遗产给林枫，所以他耽误了自己的病。

林枫一直很努力，他勤工俭学，每年拿最高额的奖学金，他想要依靠自己的努力改变命运，完成爷爷的意愿，但渐渐的林枫明白，在那拼爹的年代，努力不代表能够成功。

在大四实习的时候，单位在酒店举行酒会，酒会上，一名富家子弟把和他一起实习的女同学灌醉了，结果单位的人很默契的走开了，林枫当然知道要发生什么，所以他阻止了。

结果就是他四年的努力化为乌有，他被学校开除了，理由是非礼女同学，而且证据确凿，因为那名女同学亲口指认他。

至于另外一个结果就是，他吃官司了，他帮助的那名女同学和那富家子弟一起状告他，人证物证俱在，没钱没势的林枫这场官司根本不需要打，他的人生几乎已经注定，蹲个十年八年号子，然后和社会彻底脱轨。

当看到那富家子弟和那位女同学兴高采烈的搂在一起，在一辆奥迪车中卿卿我我之时，林枫抢了一辆车，然后带着微笑，冲向了那辆奥迪，林枫依稀记得那两张恐惧而肮脏的面容，浊世中的肮脏。

在前世，林枫已经没有任何牵挂，所以他并不因穿越而郁闷，他郁闷的是，他穿越到了一名废物少爷身上，有着废武魂的少爷。

这和他同名的林家少爷本来是云海宗外门子弟，在云海宗的时候被自己的堂兄欺凌，殴打成伤，然后一脚踹出了宗门，半死不活，也正是因此林枫才能够乘虚而入，穿越到他身上。

“既然重活一世，我绝不会让悲剧再重演。”躺在床上的林枫握紧自己的双拳，对着那还舍不得彻底散去的一缕残魂道：“你放心吧，以后你就是我，我就是你，我绝不会让自己再受欺凌。”

融合了原来‘林枫’的大部分灵魂，林枫已经很清楚自己所处的世界是一个怎样的世界，强者为尊，只要你足够的强大，任何权势在你面前都需要俯首，包括至高无上的皇权。

而想要成为武道强者，除了需要高人一等的天赋外，还要一颗强者的心以及无比坚韧的强大意志，以前的少爷‘林枫’有些懦弱，但现在的他不同，两世为人，又经历过苦难的磨练以及死亡的考验，他的心志比那少爷‘林枫’不知道要坚韧多少。

仿佛是感觉到了林枫强烈的意志，那一缕残魂终于慢慢变弱，最终，两具灵魂，完美的融合在一起。

“轰！”灵魂融合的刹那，林枫只觉魂魄震颤，直接将他震晕来，不省人事。

不知道多久，林枫再一次睁开眼睛，眉头微微皱着，仔细的感受着那一缕灵魂的悸动。

坐了起来，林枫意念一动，顿时，一股特殊的气息在空间处蔓延，林枫感觉此刻的自己被一团迷蒙的虚影包裹着，一团黑色的虚影。

“你听说了吗，林枫那废物还没醒，我看八成是已经死了。”

“嘿嘿，像他这种废物不如早点死了算了，丢我们林家的脸。”

远处，两人谈话的声音传入林枫的耳中，林枫却并没有动怒，而是露出了一丝怪异的神色，这声音显然是从很远传来的，但此刻的他却听得一清二楚，不仅如此，方圆几百米之地任何风吹草动，似乎都瞒不过他的耳朵。

而且，林枫发现自己的视力更好了，甚至连思维都仿佛敏锐了许多，在武道上他很多不明白的地方都豁然开朗。

意念再动，一条小蛇虚影出现在林枫的身后，微小的体型卷缩着，这就是他被人取笑的废武魂，不知道是什么蛇类，竟无法增幅他的能力。

不过此刻的林枫丝毫没有因为小蛇武魂而懊恼，反而显得有些呆滞，随即脸上露出了一丝灿烂的笑容，没错，他身后的那团黑色虚影是一种武魂，新觉醒的武魂，虽然还不知道这黑影是什么武魂，但加上小蛇虚影武魂，他就拥有了两种武魂。

两种武魂拥有者，被称为双生武魂，而在大陆上，拥有双生武魂的武修，都是天才，而被人称为废物的林枫，此刻却拥有了双生武魂。

“就暂时叫你黑暗武魂吧。”林枫微微一笑，自己能够拥有双生武魂应该是融合灵魂的缘故，他的灵魂可是融合了两个人的灵魂，拥有双生武魂也不奇怪，至于这武魂的能力，从目前看来应该是提升身体素质。

闭上眼睛，林枫开始入定修炼，天地元气顿时顺着林枫的四肢百骸进入林枫体内，淬炼肉身，滋养武魂。

两个时辰后，林枫停止修炼，鼻息中喷出一口乳白色的浊气，只觉浑身清爽，说不出的畅快，甚至连身体的酸痛都感觉不到了。

“这就是武者的修炼，好神奇。”林枫看着自己的双拳，用力一握，噼里啪啦的声响传出，充满了力量。

修炼速度似乎比记忆中快了很多，林枫走出了房间，眼前是一个巨大的院落，院落中有木桩、有巨石柱，这些都是用来给林枫他修炼用的。

走到石柱前，林枫运起武技九重浪，顿时拳风呼啸，划破空气，仿佛有着一重重波浪扭曲着空间。

就在此时，林枫嘴中发出一声爆喝，沉腰、收腹、出拳，狂霸的一拳如流星般撞击在了石柱上面，轰隆的巨响声传出，石柱直接化为一堆石块粉尘，铺洒在地面上。

不仅如此，拳风破碎石柱后依旧朝前，空气中传出几道爆响之声，重重空气波浪向前，撞击在另外一块石柱上，顿时又一声炸响声传出，相隔两米巨大石柱，先后碎裂。

“这应该有六千斤以上力量吧。”林枫非常满意这种效果，如今的他实力已经恢复到了巅峰，气武境五重，而他所修的武技九重浪，比以前更强了，突破到了六重浪，因此他才能够以气武境五重境界发出六千斤巨力。

“看来黑暗武魂不仅能够增强视觉听觉，还提升了我修炼速度和悟性。”林枫微微一笑，以前他被称为废物除了武魂的原因外，便是修炼慢悟性差，天赋高的人在他这年龄都已经到达了气武境六重境界或者更高，而他才气武境五重，不仅如此，他对武技的领悟能力也差强人意，在只修炼九重浪一种武技的情况下竟然一直停留在五重浪无法突破，被人耻笑。

然而现在，他所担心的武道资质问题随着黑暗武魂的诞生，似乎也不存在了。

能够全面提升武道素质的武魂，看来黑暗武魂不是一般的武魂呢。
content_en:
In the Jiuxiao Continent, martial arts are respected. Weak warriors have the strength of thousands or thousands of kilograms to break open monuments and rocks; powerful warriors can cut off rivers and split mountains; there are even emperors of martial arts who can penetrate the sky and the earth and travel through Taixu.

Martial arts determines fate, life and death. The weak will be bullied, but the strong will overlook the world.

Martial spirit, the innate talent of people in Jiuxiao Continent, is the soul of a warrior. It can be said that a warrior's achievements are closely related to his martial spirit.

There are countless types of martial spirits, including natural martial spirits, such as flames, ice souls, hurricanes, thunder and lightning, etc.; there are weapon martial spirits, such as knives, spears, swords, and halberds; there are animal martial spirits, such as white tigers, wild rhinoceros, violent apes, and dragon snakes; and of course there are many powerful exotic martial spirits, such as crazy martial spirits and immortal martial spirits; martial spirits can continue to evolve and become stronger as the warrior's strength increases.

Lin Feng opened his eyes and stared at the antique room in front of him, a strange yet familiar room, with a helpless and bitter smile in his eyes.

"This can be considered an escape from the catastrophe!" Lin Feng muttered in his heart, and his bitter smile suddenly disappeared, and a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth.

That's right, Lin Feng traveled through time. He was originally a senior student in Jiangnan City, the Chinese nation on Earth. Because of a car accident, he traveled through time to the Nine Heavens Continent and possessed a child of a family with the same name as him.

Lin Feng was a little depressed, but it was not because of time travel. On earth, he was an orphan and was raised by his grandfather. Because he was overworked, his grandfather finally closed his eyes with peace of mind when he saw Lin Feng's university admission notice. He left a deposit of tens of thousands of yuan, which was considered very rich in the countryside, for Lin Feng to study in college. Just to leave this inheritance to Lin Feng, he delayed his illness.

Lin Feng has always worked hard. He worked and studied hard and received the highest scholarship every year. He wanted to rely on his own efforts to change his destiny and fulfill his grandfather's wishes. But gradually Lin Feng understood that in those days of fighting for his father, hard work did not mean success.

During my internship in my senior year, my work unit held a cocktail party in a hotel. At the cocktail party, a young man from a rich family got the female classmate who was interning with him drunk. As a result, the people in the unit walked away in a tacit understanding. Of course, Lin Feng knew what was going to happen, so he stopped him.

As a result, his four years of hard work were in vain. He was expelled from the school for indecently assaulting a female classmate, and the evidence was conclusive because the female classmate personally identified him.

As for another result, he was in a lawsuit. The female classmate he helped sued him together with the rich boy. There were both witnesses and physical evidence. Lin Feng, who had no money and no power, did not need to fight this lawsuit. His life was almost destined to be a prostitute for ten or eight years, and then completely derailed from society.

When he saw the rich boy and the female classmate hugging each other happily and making love to each other in an Audi car, Lin Feng grabbed a car, and then rushed towards the Audi with a smile. Lin Feng vaguely remembered the fearful and dirty faces of the two, the filth in the troubled world.

In his previous life, Lin Feng no longer had any worries, so he was not depressed about time traveling. What he was depressed about was that he time traveled to a useless young master with a useless martial spirit.

The young master of the Lin family who has the same name as him was originally a disciple of the outer sect of the Yunhai Sect. When he was in the Yunhai Sect, he was bullied by his cousin, beaten to injuries, and then kicked out of the sect. He was half-dead. It was precisely because of this that Lin Feng was able to take advantage of the situation and time travel to him.

"Now that I have resurrected my life, I will never let the tragedy happen again." Lying on the bed, Lin Feng clenched his fists and said to the remnant soul that was still reluctant to completely dissipate: "Don't worry, you will be me from now on, and I will be you, and I will never let myself be bullied again."

Integrating most of the soul of the original 'Lin Feng', Lin Feng already knows what kind of world he is in. The strong is respected. As long as you are strong enough, any power must bow before you, including the supreme imperial power.

To become a strong martial artist, in addition to superior talent, you also need a strong heart and an extremely tenacious will. In the past, the young master 'Lin Feng' was a bit cowardly, but now he is different. He has been through hardships and the test of death in two lifetimes. His will is much tougher than that of the young master 'Lin Feng'.

As if sensing Lin Feng's strong will, the remnant soul finally slowly weakened, and finally, the two souls merged together perfectly.

"Boom!" At the moment when his souls merged, Lin Feng felt his soul tremble, knocking him unconscious.

I don't know how long it took, but Lin Feng opened his eyes again, frowning slightly, and carefully felt the throbbing of his soul.

Sitting up, Lin Feng's thoughts moved. Suddenly, a special aura spread in the space. Lin Feng felt that he was wrapped in a misty shadow at this moment, a black shadow.

"Have you heard that that good-for-nothing Lin Feng hasn't woken up yet? I think he's probably dead."

"Hehe, it's better for a loser like him to die as soon as possible. It will disgrace our Lin family."

In the distance, the sound of the two people talking reached Lin Feng's ears. Lin Feng was not angry, but showed a strange expression. The sound obviously came from a long distance, but he could hear it clearly at this moment. Not only that, any disturbance within a few hundred meters of radius seemed to be invisible to his ears.

Moreover, Lin Feng found that his eyesight was better, and even his thinking seemed to be much sharper. Many things he did not understand in martial arts suddenly became clear.

When his mind moved again, a small snake appeared behind Lin Feng, its tiny body curled up. This was the useless martial soul he was teased about. He didn't know what kind of snake it was, but it couldn't increase his ability.

However, at this moment, Lin Feng was not upset at all because of the Little Snake Martial Spirit. Instead, he looked a little sluggish, and then a bright smile appeared on his face. Yes, the black shadow behind him was a kind of Martial Spirit, a newly awakened Martial Spirit. Although he still didn't know what kind of Martial Spirit this black shadow was, but with the addition of the Little Snake Shadow Martial Spirit, he had two kinds of martial arts.

The owners of the two kinds of martial souls are called twin martial souls. On the mainland, martial arts cultivators with twin martial souls are all geniuses. However, Lin Feng, who was called a waste, now possesses twin martial souls.

"Let me call you Dark Martial Spirit for now." Lin Feng smiled slightly. He was able to have twin Martial Spirits probably because of the fusion of souls. His soul was the fusion of two people's souls. It is not surprising to have twin Martial Spirits. As for the ability of this martial soul, it seems that it can improve physical fitness.

Closing his eyes, Lin Feng began to practice meditation. The vitality of heaven and earth immediately entered Lin Feng's body along Lin Feng's limbs and bones, tempering his body and nourishing his martial soul.

Two hours later, Lin Feng stopped practicing and blew out a breath of milky white turbid air. His whole body felt refreshed and indescribably comfortable. He could not even feel the pain in his body.

"This is the training of a warrior, it's so magical." Lin Feng looked at his fists and clenched them hard, making a crackling sound, full of power.

The speed of cultivation seemed to be much faster than in memory. Lin Feng walked out of the room. In front of him was a huge courtyard. There were wooden piles and huge stone pillars in the courtyard. These were used for Lin Feng to practice.

Walking to the stone pillar, Lin Feng used the Nine Waves of Martial Arts, and the wind of his fist roared suddenly, cutting through the air, as if there were multiple waves distorting the space.

At this moment, Lin Feng let out a loud shout, lowered his waist, tightened his abdomen, and punched. The violent punch hit the stone pillar like a meteor. A loud booming sound was heard, and the stone pillar turned into a pile of stone dust and spread on the ground.

Not only that, after the fist wind shattered the stone pillar, it still moved forward. Several explosion sounds were heard in the air. Heavy air waves moved forward and hit another stone pillar. Suddenly, another explosion sound was heard, and the huge stone pillars two meters apart were shattered one after another.

"This should have a power of more than six thousand kilograms." Lin Feng was very satisfied with this effect. Now his strength has returned to its peak, the fifth level of the Qi Martial Realm, and the ninth level of martial arts he has practiced is stronger than before, breaking through to the sixth level. Therefore, he can exert a huge force of six thousand kilograms at the fifth level of the Qi Martial Realm.

"It seems that the dark martial arts can not only enhance my vision and hearing, but also improve my cultivation speed and understanding." Lin Feng smiled slightly. In the past, he was called a waste. In addition to the martial arts, he was slow in cultivation and poor in understanding. People with high talents at his age have alreadyHe has reached the sixth level of Qi Martial Realm or higher, and he is only at the fifth level of Qi Martial Realm. Not only that, his ability to comprehend martial arts is also unsatisfactory. Even though he only practiced one kind of martial art, Jiu Ling Lang, he stayed at the fifth level and was unable to break through, and was ridiculed by others.

However, now, with the birth of the Dark Martial Spirit, the martial arts qualifications issue he was worried about seemed to no longer exist.

A martial spirit that can comprehensively improve the quality of martial arts. It seems that the dark martial spirit is not an ordinary martial spirit.
